summary: Builds or modifies SOP geometry from DAT tables describing points, vertices, primitives, and detail attributes.

key_params.name: pointsdat
key_params.note: DAT containing point rows and point attributes.

key_params.name: merge
key_params.note: Whether and how DAT data merges with existing geometry.

key_params.name: float
key_params.note: Create float attributes from DAT columns.

key_params.name: int
key_params.note: Create integer attributes from DAT columns.

key_params.name: string
key_params.note: Create string attributes from DAT columns.

key_params.name: n
key_params.note: Count used by generated primitive construction.

common_gotchas: Vertex DATs need both point index and vertex index columns when modifying existing geometry.
Unnamed point DATs use a fixed column order, so headers are safer for durable cards and examples.
The official point-sprite particle render value uses legacy spelling; avoid silently correcting parameter ids.
key_concepts: DAT to SOP can build new geometry from DAT tables or merge DAT-authored attributes into existing SOP geometry.
Point, vertex, primitive, and detail DATs each define different geometry layers through their headers and rows.
Merge modes require index columns so incoming rows can target existing points, vertices, primitives, or detail records.
Primitive build controls create polygons, meshes, Bezier/NURBS primitives, particles, and point-render primitives from table data.
